**Role:** 
 Delivery Excellence Partner (DERM)
 



**Skill:** 
 Finance and Accounts
 



**Experience:**

**Shift Timing:** 
 24x7 (Should be open to work in all shifts)
 



  





**Education:** 




 • Minimum 15 years of regular, full\-time education (10 \+ 2 \+ 3\)
 



 • Non\-technical graduation and/or masters in finance \& accounts stream \- MCOM, MBA in Finance, CA/ICWA or Engineering background with proven black belt or transformation expertise in Finance and Accounts processes.
 



  





**Must Have:** 




 • BPO exposure in process improvement and Quality.
 



 • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified and experience in driving LSS/ Process Improvement projects.
 



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 




 • Black Belt /Master Black Belt certified
 



 • Exposure to finance \& Accounting domain on process improvements \& quality deployment.
 



 • Experience in RPA /Agentic AI deployments.
 



 • Exposure to CMMi/ISO certifications.
 



  





**The purpose of the job or role:** 




 • To drive Data driven culture in operation by imparting various quality tools and methodologies trainings.
 



 • To ensure that the best in class client satisfaction rating is achieved by leveraging Delivery Excellence initiatives.
 



 • To facilitate deployment of Quality management system(iQMS) including ISO and CMMi practices.
 



 • To drive business process improvements leveraging Lean Six Sigma.
 



  





**Primary Responsibilities:** 




 • Conduct Thought leadership workshops and develop continuous improvement roadmap for the associated client accounts.
 



 • Lead \& mentor Process Improvement projects leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies to deliver targeted Business value and productivity improvements.
 



 • Build and develop competencies on Quality Management Systems, Lean Six Sigma and digital transformation techniques.
 



 • Drive innovation and automation projects to deliver award winning case studies in internal and external forums.
 



 • Drive effective No Surprise framework to ensure process risks are proactively identified and mitigated for the associated client accounts.
 



 • Effectively engage with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure Delivery Excellence Initiatives are effectively deployed and recognized.
 



  





**Critical Success Factors:** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • An eye for detail, analytical and data oriented with logical problem solving approach.
 



 • Client and Stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Influencing Skills.
 



 • Program management skills – soft skills \& networking.
 



 • Assertive \& self driven with an attitude of challenging the status quo.
 



 • Ambitious or Goal oriented with a will to make it happen.
 



  





**Education/Certification/Experience Requirements:** 




 • Overall 10\+ plus years of work experience with proven expertise in business problem solving and delivering significant business value to the clients and internal stakeholders. Exposure to Service industry is must.
 



 • Should be able to demonstrate experience in practical application of Lean Six Sigma techniques, Automation, etc. Experience in deploying Data analytics, Machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, etc., would be an advantage.
 



 • LSS Green belt must. QMS, Black Belt, Master Black belt, Agile, Digital competencies and PMP certifications would be an advantage.
 



 • At least 4 years of experience as Lean Six Sigma or Transformation professional for FAO processes is must.
 



 • Educational Requirements: MCOM, MBA in Finance, CA/ICWA or Engineering background with proven black belt or transformation expertise in FAO processes.
 



 • Shift: Willing to work in all shifts and willing to travel to any location as per client/organization requirements.
